source.sharedPromptContract: One bespoke Rush & Revenue Online game inventory icon matching the painterly semi-realistic isolated-object rendering, elevated three-quarter view, tactile professional materials, restrained highlights, clean silhouette, and visual weight of the accepted style reference. Center the complete subject on a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma-key background with generous padding and readability at 64px. No gradient, texture, floor plane, cast/contact shadow, reflection, magenta subject material, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, brands, logos, watermark, people, hands, border, frame, room, unrelated props, or procedural emblem.
source.runtimeResize: trim transparent bounds, scale proportionally to at most 116x116, center on a 128x128 transparent canvas
source.notes: The preserved high-resolution files are post-chroma alpha sources. Seven are 1254x1254; the wide sharpening-strip source is 1536x1024. Runtime assets are the 128x128 PNGs under apps/client-godot/assets/items; dark, light, and all-32 comparison sheets are retained as visual QA evidence.

items.name: Steam-Shell Gauntlets

items.semanticVerdict: pass: paired armored waterproof palms and long splash-sealed cuffs read as premium steam/chemical gauntlets rather than thin cleaning gloves

items.name: Enzymatic Detergent Dose

items.semanticVerdict: pass: rigid squat dosing cartridge, molded concentrate reservoir and break-off neck distinguish it from the flat deliming pouch and other consumables

items.name: Quick Deliming Pouch

items.semanticVerdict: pass: flexible foil, tear notches and mineral-scale wash-arm pictogram read as a deliming maintenance pouch without writing

items.name: Forged Eight-Inch Chef Knife
items.subjectPrompt: One balanced eight-inch professional chef knife with a broad gently curved forged stainless blade, distal taper, subtle hammered upper face, satin cutting bevel, thick heel and full bolster, plus a dark walnut full-tang handle with three flush brass rivets.
items.semanticVerdict: pass: broad curved forged blade, hammered upper face and riveted full-tang walnut handle read immediately as a chef knife rather than a cleaver or utility blade

items.name: Fast-Read Folding Thermometer
items.subjectPrompt: One professional folding food thermometer opened to an obtuse angle, with a compact burnt-orange and dark-teal rubberized body, long stainless probe, visible metal pivot, protected screen showing only three doneness color zones and a circular lock indicator, and two blank tactile buttons.
items.semanticVerdict: pass: hinged probe, visible pivot and color-zone body are unmistakably a folding thermometer and remain distinct from the sanitizer strip reader

items.name: Offset Plating Tweezers
items.subjectPrompt: One long pair of professional offset plating tweezers with satin stainless spring arms, a clearly visible parallel offset bend near fine serrated tips, dark-teal grip panels, a burnt-orange tension collar, and slightly open jaws.
items.semanticVerdict: pass: open twin arms and pronounced parallel offset tips read as precision plating tweezers rather than tongs, scissors, or a thermometer probe

items.name: Tasting Spoon Wallet
items.subjectPrompt: One compact washable dark-teal canvas utensil roll opened partway, revealing six identical small stainless tasting spoons in individual cream stitched pockets, with orderly spoon bowls, nested handles, burnt-orange tie strap, reinforced wipe-clean edging, and folded flap.
items.semanticVerdict: pass: repeated spoon bowls, individual stitched pockets and rolled canvas form clearly identify a sanitary tasting-spoon wallet rather than a generic pouch or folio

items.name: Diamond Sharpening Strip
items.subjectPrompt: One wide flexible blade-care strip with a flat dark-gray diamond-abrasive face, coarse sparkling crosshatch grit, thin dark-teal polymer backing, burnt-orange perforated grip tab, and one corner of a pale protective liner partially peeled back.
